title: Episodes: Personal evidence sprint notebook
content:
Sprint window: Feb 10 — Mar 1
Context: lightweight personal notebook to collect "evidence episodes" (short, time-bound descriptions of impact) that I can fold into manager 1:1s, promotion narratives, and calibration prep. Not polished — quick capture, then distill.

How I use this doc:
- Capture 1–3 short episodes per week (what I did, measurable outcome, artifacts).
- Tag each episode with who to cc / potential reviewers.
- Draft a 3-bullet story for manager + one-sentence ask.
- Iterate into promotion narrative folder when I have 6–8 strong episodes.

Current goals (next 6 weeks):
- Goal A: Own cross-team calibration project and shorten decision cycle from ~7d -> <=3d for routine promotion cases (metric: avg days to decision).
- Goal B: Ship updated onboarding checklist for People Ops new hires and reduce first-30-day ramp blockers reported in survey from 36% -> 20%.
- Goal C: Run 2 office hours for ICs on career mapping (target 12 attendees, capture questions).

Evidence episodes (raw captures)
1) Feb 12 — Calibration workflow prototype
- What: Drafted and piloted a one-page decision workflow for routine senior IC promotion cases; added minimum evidence checklist and templated email cadence.
- Outcome: Piloted with Eng-SRE and Applied-ML — 2 cases closed end-to-end in 48 hours; stakeholders reported clearer next steps (Slack thread, see linked_artifacts).
- Artifacts: JIRA HR-421 (pilot case), PR: hr-templates#72, confluence page id: confluence:calibration-process-v2
- Story for manager: Reduced ambiguity in case routing; demonstrated faster turn-around when playbook used.
- Ask: Approve pilot extension to Dedicated and Platform teams (2-week runway + reviewer commit).

2) Feb 18 — Onboarding checklist v0.9
- What: Consolidated onboarding tasks across infra + product into a single checklist; added examples for access requests and key first-week meetings.
- Outcome: Early feedback from new hire cohort (n=5) showed checklist cut time to first green task by ~1.5 days (self-reported).
- Artifacts: survey results (spreadsheet link in Slack thread), onboarding-checklist.docx (draft in drive).
- Story for manager: Small operational change that improved new-hire speed and lowered support pings to infra.
- Ask: Approve 1 hour of my time to run a short sync with infra owners to finalize ownership matrix.

3) Feb 24 — Career-mapping office hour trial
- What: Ran 60min drop-in session for ICs on career ladder mapping; captured 9 questions and 3 recurring pain points.
- Outcome: 12 attendees; created a follow-up FAQ snippet and 1:1 primer for managers.
- Artifacts: notes in this doc + recorded session (private link).
- Story for manager: Demonstrated demand for structured manager guidance; created low-effort content that reduces repeat questions.
- Ask: Budget $2k for a short external workshop (career coaching) if manager agrees this should be scaled.

Quick metrics snapshot (manual):
- Rolling avg decision time (pilot cases): 2.1 days (n=4)
- New-hire first-green-task delta vs prior cohort: -1.5 days (n=5)
- Office hours attendees: 12 (1 session)

Manager 1:1 prep (next sync)
- Lead with the decision-workflow pilot: highlight metric (2.1 days) and ask to expand pilot.
- Ask for alignment on promotion calibration scope: which ladder levels we treat as "routine" vs "complex".
- Ask for mentorship budget: $2k (justification: external facilitator + materials to scale office hours into a workshop).
- Quick wins to mention: onboarding checklist early wins, office-hour demand.
- Potential risks: increasing workload if pilot expands; need a reviewer roster before scaling.

Draft one-paragraph narrative for calibration conversation:
"Over the last two weeks I piloted a concise calibration workflow for routine promotion cases that reduced average decision time to ~2 days in early trials. The pattern is repeatable — if we formalize reviewer assignments and roll the playbook out to two more teams, we can cut decision latency across the org while improving transparency for candidates and managers. I recommend a 2-week breadth pilot and an official reviewer roster to de-risk scale."

To-do (next actions):
- [ ] Build reviewer roster template and circulate to Eng leads (owner: me; due: Mar 7).
- [ ] Add checklist to onboarding repo and request infra owner review (owner: me; due: Mar 3).
- [ ] Draft workshop scope + budget deck for mentorship request (owner: me; due: Mar 14).

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Keep captures <= 5 sentences — makes it easy to paste into narratives.
- When filing as promotion evidence, map each episode to a capability in the rubric (e.g., cross-team influence, process design, impact).
- Archive low-signal items weekly; keep the top 8 episodes in a promotion-ready folder.

References / quick links: see linked_artifacts above.

End of sprint capture — will prune and distill into promotion narrative on Mar 8.
